data_status: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved sources: JPL (SSD, SBDB), NASA (NSSDC fact sheets and mission catalog, Small Spacecraft SoA report 2026, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, ), ULA, ESA, NIST, and the Launch Library 2 aggregator. Records carry source_authority/confidence where the source is an aggregator or vendor-reported compilation. Recalled, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, engine/vehicle specs without a retrievable source, the user-supplied SpaceX table) are not included. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

record.spec_note: mass/power fields are taken from the first sentence in the NASA description that states a mass in kg or a power in W; they may describe a sub-unit or a mode. Read the sentence.
record.name: Meteoroid Detectors
record.description: This experiment was designed to measure the number of meteoroid impacts on the Pioneer 11 spacecraft. The instrument was sensitive to meteoroids of mass approximately 1E-8 g. The instrumentation consisted of 234 cells pressurized with an argon-nitrogen mixture. Penetration of the 50-micrometer-thick skin of the cell resulted in the loss of gas at a rate proportional to the size of the hole. Gas loss was detected with a cold cathode device. The cells were initially pressurized to 1175 torrs at 295 deg K. The cells were formed by welding together two sheets of stainless steel in a configuration resembling an air mattress. The exposed area of each cell was 2.45E-3 sq m. The cells were mounted on the back of the high gain antenna dish. For a description of the experiment see D. H. Humes et al., J. Geophys. Res., v. 79, pp. 3677-3684, 1974. This instrument was turned off in June 1984.
record.text_extraction_note: numeric_mentions_in_text are regex matches of 'number unit' in the catalog prose, with context; they are not structured specifications.
